verdicts.evidence: Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training purposes.
verdicts.reason: The agent disclosed the recording within the first minute, in the opening turn.

verdicts.evidence: Before we get into any details or a quote, can I get your full name and date of birth, please?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked for the full name and date of birth before discussing details or a quote, and the agent read back the name and date of birth at 00:30 to confirm them.

verdicts.evidence: could you tell me a bit about your situation and what's prompting you to look at life insurance?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked about the customer's circumstances and reason for wanting cover before recommending any amount or term.

verdicts.evidence: You can choose cover anywhere from $50,000 up to $750,000. Terms are either 10 or 20 years, and your premium stays fixed for the whole term.
verdicts.reason: The stated coverage range, terms, fixed premium, no medical exam, no cash value and 30-day full-refund free-look all match the product facts. The $80 monthly premium is not in the product facts, so it could not be verified, but nothing the agent said contradicts the facts.

verdicts.evidence: No rush at all on my end. If you'd prefer to talk it over with your partner first, I can email you the quote and you can come back to it whenever suits you.
verdicts.reason: After the customer signalled she wanted to proceed, the agent offered time to decide and did not create false urgency. The customer chose to proceed that day of her own accord.

verdicts.evidence: Yes, I want to go ahead.
verdicts.reason: The agent summarised the $500,000 cover over 20 years, the $80 monthly premium, the fixed premium and the free-look period at 04:06, then asked for a decision. The customer gave a clear yes.

verdicts.evidence: I run a small bakery, I've got two kids, eight and eleven, and a mortgage.
